//: Compiles the @vscode/test-electron integration suite (src/test/**) to CommonJS in out/. Run via `pnpm test:integration`. Separate from the esbuild extension build and the Vitest unit configs. The CommonJS emit is conditional: under `module: node16` it follows the package, so adding `"type": "module"` to package.json would flip it to ESM and `node out/test/runTest.js` would stop loading.
